scripts.type-check-all: echo --Run typescript linter-- && pnpm --filter server run type-check && pnpm --filter client run type-check
scripts.format-all: pnpm --filter svara-pro-server --filter svara-pro-bot --filter svara-pro-client --filter svara-pro-service-bot format
scripts.lint-all: pnpm --filter svara-pro-server --filter svara-pro-bot --filter svara-pro-client --filter svara-pro-service-bot lint
scripts.check-all: echo --Run all pre-commit check-ups-- && npm-run-all lint-all && echo --All checks passed--
scripts.build: pnpm --filter svara-pro-server build && pnpm --filter svara-pro-bot build
scripts.install-workspaces: pnpm --filter svara-pro-server --filter svara-pro-bot --filter svara-pro-client --filter svara-pro-service-bot --frozen-lockfile install
